actions.what: Write art-direction.json: run craft direction init, then give every choice a reason from the client's world.
actions.why: the reason rule

actions.what: Pick the display face from the client's world (signage, packaging, the trade's lettering) and record why in art-direction.json. If this face really is the right one, declare an exception with the reason and the evidence.
actions.why: Second-wave reflex font (reflex-font-2, gen 2), in source and on the page; Reflex font (reflex-font, gen 1); Move off the model's pick for this brief: display Fraunces (13 of 20 null pages chose it); Differ from hjbeauty: both have Fraunces headline (sibling at 0.28)

actions.what: Derive the accent from something the client owns (livery, shopfront, product). If violet is the brand, declare it: `{ "tell": "ai-violet", "because": "..." }`.
actions.why: Indigo-violet accent (ai-violet, gen 1); Differ from hjbeauty: both have no accent (sibling at 0.28)

actions.what: Choose the shape language on purpose (and record it), then use the pill only where it means something. The limit here is 30 per scan.
actions.why: Pills everywhere (pill-everything, gen 1), in source and on the page; Move off the model's pick for this brief: shape pill (19 of 20 null pages chose it)

actions.what: Show the services as the client would: a price list, a menu board, photographs of the work, a sequence.
actions.why: Three-column icon-card grid (icon-tile-grid, gen 1), in source and on the page

actions.what: Light the page with real imagery, or leave the ground flat.
actions.why: Radial glow (radial-spotlight-glow, gen 2); Glass panel (glass-panel, gen 1); Icon in a tinted tile (icon-tile-stack, gen 2)

actions.what: Show proof still and in context: one named review, one accreditation, where the doubt arises.

actions.what: Drop it. If the fact matters, put it in the headline or the first line of copy.
